system.name: JINTER Net
system.one_liner: Neural auction that selects from the combined ads and organic items with an allocation network and a payment network.

content.variant_note: one input column feeding two stacked tinted bands, an allocation network and a payment network, each drawn neuron by neuron
content.argues: A single network that allocates slots over ads and organic items together, plus a payment network for the ads, designs the integrated auction jointly.
content.subject: Stacks of volumes, slots and bids feed a blue allocation network (two softmax tensors) and a pink payment network.

lessons.what_to_learn: Colour the dashed input boxes, the arrows and the bands of two sub-networks in matching hues (cyan and blue for one, pink for the other), so the reader sees at once which inputs feed which network; use stacks of offset cards for sets of inputs.
lessons.suits: architectures with two coupled sub-networks (allocation and payment, actor and critic, generator and discriminator) that share inputs and are drawn neuron by neuron.

evidence: an allocation network that determines the allocation probabilities for ads and organic items
a payment network that calculates the payments for ads
where m ads, n organic items and K slots serve as input.

summary: JINTER Net is a neural ad auction for e-commerce pages that mix ads and organic items: it selects from the combined set instead of ranking the two lists separately. The figure shows the network in one drawing. At the left, stacks of gradient cards stand for the volumes and bids of m ads and n organic items, and green squares stand for K slots; a cyan dashed box and arrow lead the inputs into the Allocation Network (blue band), a pink dashed box and arrow into the Payment Network (pink band). The allocation band draws fully connected layers of neurons ending in two groups of outputs, a column-wise and a row-wise softmax drawn as tensor stacks, and the allocation matrix x. The payment band ends in sigmoid units and the payments p, which are also fed by x through dotted blue arrows.
summary_zh: JINTER Net 结构图：左侧卡片堆表示广告与自然条目的流量、出价，绿色方块表示展示位；青色、粉色虚线框和箭头把输入分别送入蓝色分配网络与粉色支付网络，分配矩阵 x 经蓝色虚线进入支付网络得到 p。
notes: The context gives no definition of the symbols q, e, 𝕀, c, r or of the dotted lines from the payment input layer into p̃, so those roles are left open. The digest counts 105 bitmaps because gradient fills (neurons, cards, bands) are stored as images; they are not data samples, so pictures is empty. Icon counts are by eye.
